set_current.name: Set charging current
set_current.description: Updates the dynamic charging current limit. 0 A pauses charging; other values must be at least 6 A and are capped at the wallbox variant's maximum.

config_entry_id.name: Wallbox
config_entry_id.description: Config entry of the wallbox. Optional when only one wallbox is configured.

amps.name: Current
amps.description: Charging current in ampere: 0 to pause, otherwise 6 to 32.

set_failsafe.name: Configure fail-safe
set_failsafe.description: Sets the fallback charging current and the timeout used when the energy manager stops sending keep-alives.

config_entry_id.name: Wallbox
config_entry_id.description: Config entry of the wallbox. Optional when only one wallbox is configured.

amps.name: Fallback current
amps.description: Charging current enforced during fail-safe operation.

timeout_s.name: Timeout
timeout_s.description: Seconds without a keep-alive before fail-safe mode activates.

send_keepalive.name: Send keep-alive
send_keepalive.description: Writes the life bit once to tell the wallbox that the energy manager is still present. The integration already does this automatically.

config_entry_id.name: Wallbox
config_entry_id.description: Config entry of the wallbox. Optional when only one wallbox is configured.

start_session.name: Start charging session
start_session.description: Starts a charging session (Webasto Next only).

config_entry_id.description: Config entry of the wallbox. Optional when only one wallbox is configured.

stop_session.name: Stop charging session
stop_session.description: Cancels the active charging session (Webasto Next only).
